mentions.title: Class 4B trip to Bled
mentions.notes: Pack a packed lunch and a warm jacket. Parents welcome to join the lake walk at 13:00.
mentions.quote: our class trip to Bled is on Friday 6 November. The bus leaves school at 7:40 and we are back about 16:00. Please pack a packed lunch and a warm jacket. Parents are welcome to join the lake walk at 13:00.

mentions.title: Pay trip fee and return signed permission slip
mentions.quote: The trip costs 22 EUR, to be paid together with the signed permission slip by Thursday 29 October.
